summary: Persist native verification milestones and bounded progress in balance-history file logs
details: Record verification and scan boundaries, aggregate comparison results, row counts, digests, durations, average throughput, baseline publication and sealed-baseline reuse through the existing rotating service logger.

Limit advancing file-log progress to once per minute per stage while retaining existing ten-second monitor observations and container progress. Failed or cancelled verification records the last observed stage and count, and startup failures flush the logger before exit.
Preserve all canonical scans, digest encodings, cancellation checks and publication gates. No additional database traversal, configuration migration or historical log backfill is introduced.
operator_actions: Upgrade the matching usdb-services image. Inspect logs/balance-history_rCURRENT.log and rotated files under the balance-history data directory after container recreation.
Keep INFO logging enabled to retain these milestones; normal log rotation and retention still apply. No data rebuild is required.
